decisions: JAYA_MASTER_AUTONOMOUS_DEV_GUIDE_v3.md is the highest-authority specification; the v1.0 guide is subordinate compatible detail.
Begin as a bounded modular monolith, preserving module-owned data and public API/event contracts.
No implementation capability may be marked complete without repository evidence and applicable test results.
DOC-001 planning baseline is accepted; FND-001 is the first implementation task.
FND-001 will be delivered as separately reviewable subtasks, beginning with the local executable toolchain before CI and boundary enforcement.
The exact .nvmrc value is the pinned development runtime, while engines.node may remain a compatible supported-runtime range; packageManager must identify an exact npm version.
FND-001a is accepted as delivered, not as completion of FND-001 or Phase 0.
concerns: There is no CI, database, authentication, deployment, or monitoring foundation yet.
The eventual production/staging environments and external provider credentials may require later human or cloud-access escalation, but do not block local foundation work.
The baseline requirement count is extensive and must remain mechanically verifiable as statuses change.
Boundary enforcement must not be bypassable through unresolved path forms, runtime indirection, re-exports, dynamic imports, or unregistered source units.
GitHub currently reports no checks, so CI workflow execution evidence will be required before P0-09 can be accepted.
The provider SDK denylist is configuration-based and must be maintained whenever providers are adopted; broad provider scopes reduce but do not eliminate this maintenance risk.
Persistent status documentation currently contains contradictory pre-FND-001b statements, undermining its role as authoritative project memory.
last_instruction: Reconcile the repository documentation for FND-001b only: audit CURRENT_IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md, MASTER_IMPLEMENTATION_CHECKLIST.md, and affected root READMEs/package metadata for stale pre-FND-001b claims, then make every status, count, next-task statement, limitation, and completion-language statement agree with the delivered boundary implementation and its evidence without marking FND-001 or Phase 0 complete. At minimum correct CURRENT_IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md §5, §8, §10, §11 and platform/README.md; preserve P0-03 and P0-11 as complete only if their checklist evidence blocks support that status, and keep P0-10 in progress. Run the documentation link validator and a clean `npm ci && npm run verify`, record the exact current results, commit this bounded documentation correction, and report the commit and command outputs without starting FND-001c.
